scenario_policy.detail: Scope reads are pure; pump every participant before exactly 2 ms advance. Capture 10 ms, privacy 5 ms for pilot / 10 ms for endpoint, PCM rate, 60 ms unmute, sample-count silence/result policies and finite session lengths remain in logical time. Scope is test-thread local; unscoped threads remain host-clock. Shutdown pumps do not advance logical time.

real_child_events.detail: Actual process exec/start marker, close/kill, waitid(WNOWAIT) and supervisor wait/reap remain real. Stepped pilot peers observe each owned cat exit before the next logical step; real 300 ms per-stop/shared-shutdown deadline is a guard, not normally an elapsed 300 ms.

sleeping_fixture_cleanup.detail: Four sentinel workers execute sleep 60 and cannot obey the mocked Stop. They consume the one shared real 300 ms shutdown grace before forced kill/reap. The 60 seconds is keepalive, not normal elapsed test time. This remains in all six stepped endpoint cases and each finite early-end / real-process endpoint session.

metadata_finish.detail: Writer is proven blocked before the stepped run; real SIGTERM and real child reap remain. finish_logging consumes the unchanged real FINISH_WAIT=500 ms while the writer remains blocked, then the release token permits actual completion. The 2 s entry recv_timeout and FINISH_WAIT+250 ms upper assertion are guards.

rapid_privacy_cycles.detail: Four complete threaded answer/mute cycles; paced 10 ms capture and PCM, 5 ms privacy mock, real 60 ms stable unmute via wait_worker before each run. Service wait 2 ms, authority refresh 25 ms, independent privacy/peer threads. Child exit and next-cycle no-overlap remain actual. The 5 s privacy mock / 12 s scenario limits are guards.

early_end_finite.detail: Finite 4/5/6 s sessions (the comparison case runs two 5 s sessions), capture/privacy paced 10 ms, scripted answer-after delay and 40 ms packet schedule, sample-count 200 ms early / 600 ms final silence. Provider and service use a separate current-thread unpaused Tokio runtime; three peripheral OS threads use host monotonic/std Instant. 350 ms playout setting is PCM buffer capacity, not a fixed timer.

early_end_host_guards.detail: 3 s Ready/task-publication guard; 12 s conversation watchdog; service 1 ms rest, 20 ms dial receive timeout, 5 ms stop checks and peripheral 1 ms polls. Startup must establish real Ready before sample producers. Cleanup aborts scripted sends before provider Stop, then joins tasks/threads and propagates unexpected panics.

endpoint_real_process.detail: ProcessClassifier owns writer/reader/supervisor threads, std Instant/Condvar deadlines and actual child try_wait/kill/wait. Defaults startup 10 s, hang 2 s, 2 restarts/backoff 1 s, grace/drain 300 ms; only scenario-selected paths consume them. Finite host sessions retain capture/privacy schedules; missing-model child exit is event-driven.

endpoint_mute.detail: Mute is event-triggered, not a finite session sleep. Cooperative peer cats stop on stdin close, but endpoint sleep 60 ignores EOF: default grace 300 ms is consumed before kill/reap. The unconfirmed case uses 1500 ms endpoint grace with coordinator max(remaining shared grace,500 ms) confirmation bound; that 500 ms must expire while exit remains unconfirmed. Two-cycle reopen checks actual previous PID absence.

provider_mixed_clocks.detail: LiveRig is one in-process Tokio task plus real local IPC sockets, no OS child. Controller/leases, stamps and worker intake read host monotonic_us; timing helpers and speaker read std Instant; worker 2 ms and Gemini 10 ms ticker/recovery/protocol deadlines use Tokio. 100000 us leases/retained input and Gemini capture age are real checks, not sleeps. LinkClock correlates Tokio and host samples and rejects independent clock stops/regression.

provider_guards.detail: LiveRig output/wire 5 s, dial/service-message/exit 3 s guards; 2 ms wire/dial loops, 5 ms heartbeat/receive polls, 1 ms exit loop. Keepalive/setup/response deadlines are safeguards unless explicitly exercised. Speaker completion has answer-seconds+120 s guard. Pausing only Tokio leaves std/monotonic loops running until real deadlines.

capacity_answer.detail: 20 s answer at 24000 samples/s plus full 4 s playback hold after 5 s; 5 s buffer. 3 s network stall, 200 ms non-burst service gaps, largest messages and five-message burst, idle withheld through answer duration. std Instant drives Speaker backlog/starvation/held counters and all original timing/capacity assertions. Intervals overlap, so do not sum every delay.

kept_patience.detail: Twenty input blocks each paced 10 ms, 60 ms silence-drain windows, unchanged 2500 ms kept-start patience then strict 2000 ms barrier timeout; final 20 ms negative receive. 4 s loop limits are guards. The silence helper resets its std Instant at each actually received message.

assumed_barrier.detail: Two runs, Legacy and Typed; silent service must consume original 2000 ms AssumeAfterQuiet barrier, with original >=1900 ms assertion, then output and live worker assertions.

name_bus_window.detail: Name is published only after began_us+4000000: selected offsets are +1000000 after end or +200000 after beginning; then 200 ms pump. Real bus publication/delivery, global BUS_ROOT isolation and serialized tests remain; NameIn polls supplied monotonic at 20000 us and drains at most 8. A delivered datagram is not proof worker consumed it.

direct_supervisor_quiet.detail: Two branches continued/abandoned each drain 150,100,150,150 ms silence windows; total configured quiet windows 1100 ms. Direct Supervisor plus in-memory Tokio duplex service; no LiveRig/leases/LinkClock/coordinator/OS child. 3 s timeout is guard; std Instant capture stamps remain host.
